title: Shared definitions for the hardening registry
description: Common definitions referenced by the other registry schemas. The $id URIs under beyond-prompting.example are opaque identifiers, not fetched URLs; consumers register these documents in a local schema registry before validating.

version_range.description: Inclusive minimum and maximum Hermes versions this control was checked against, with the evidence basis for that check stated explicitly. minimum must not exceed maximum (checked by the registry validator). The basis is part of the claim: a range with basis documentation or illustrative is never presented as exercised verification.

basis.description: exercised: the control's behaviour was actually exercised on builds inside this range. documentation: the surrounding procedures or official documentation were read against builds in this range; no behavioural verification is claimed. illustrative: a synthetic placeholder range on a synthetic example control; no compatibility claim at all.

scalar.description: A single comparable inventory value. Null is deliberately excluded: an absent fact is represented by the fact being missing, never by null.

predicate.description: Three-valued applicability predicate over inventory facts. Evaluation is Kleene logic: a missing or type-mismatched fact evaluates to UNKNOWN, never to false. An empty all_of list is vacuously true; an empty any_of list is false.

fact.description: Dotted path into the metadata-safe inventory, for example deployment.exposure.

value.description: Comparison value. Required for every operator except exists and not_exists, where it is forbidden.
